records.subject: A few days into Wrenfield -- how's it going?
records.body:
Hi Kai,

Wanted to check whether the onboarding made sense or whether anything got in the way. No action needed if everything's going smoothly.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Ridge Systems!
records.body:
Hi Kai,

Welcome aboard! Wrenfield is built for teams, so it gets more useful once at least one other person is in it -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Happy to help if you hit a wall.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

decisions.rationale: 6 days in, no project, no invite, no milestone, no tickets. Welcome email [email:4dbf212b] and welcome call [calendar:f9e50cc8] produced no activity, and the day-3 check-in [email:b98ee305] got no reply. Silence after a held call suggests low self-serve momentum, though Pro plan and 8 days left leave some chance.

draft.subject: Getting Ridge Systems' first project started
draft.body:
Hi Kai,

It was good talking last week. I noticed things have been quiet since, so I wanted to check in before the week gets away from us.

In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so getting a first one set up is usually the step that makes everything else click. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm glad to walk through that first project with you.

Best,
Priya
